prompt: The camera does not move. Brandon sits bolt upright and pats his cheeks with both palms, three quick pats, eyes wide and brows high. Later his hands drop to his lap, he looks down at himself and his mouth widens into a disbelieving grin. Dust drifts in the shaft of light from the skylight. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Quick soft palm slaps on skin, duvet fabric shifting, a pigeon walking on the skylight glass, floorboard creak. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
